description: MATCH TYPE REFERENCE (rows with match_type=note are ignored by the script - keep or delete freely)
startswith = pattern must match the START of the filename. Example: '.' matches any hidden dotfile like .DS_Store
exact = filename must match the pattern EXACTLY, the whole string. Example: 'Thumbs.db' matches only Thumbs.db
endswith = pattern must match the END of the filename. Example: '.csv' matches report.csv, data.csv, etc.
contains = pattern can appear ANYWHERE in the filename. Example: '_proxy_' matches show_proxy_v2.mov
match_type must be spelled exactly: startswith, exact, endswith, or contains - anything else (including these note rows) is skipped
crop sample image, matches anywhere in filename e.g. tape123_crop_after_sample12.png
crop sample image, matches anywhere in filename e.g. tape123_crop_before_sample12.png
